title: Verification record carries a run.command rebuilt from the mode, which is wrong for category and live runs
outcome: A verification record's run.command is the launcher invocation that actually ran. A category run is recorded as category NAME, not as a focused run. A live run keeps its --engram-binary and --engram-sha256 pins and its named tests. Today the launcher does not record its own argv, and src/engram_verification_record.rs (around line 711) rebuilds the command from the mode alone. Fix direction: createRun records the launcher argv in request.json, which engram_verification_record_recorded_command already prefers; alternatively, build the command from scope.kind and the liveEngram fields. Source: Low from the Claude review (delegation 0c70316c) of committed-input candidate 637616e6.
acceptance: Verification record carries a run.command rebuilt from the mode, which is wrong for category and live runs is done
